author: Copilot
body: `setQueryData()` stores `{ status: 'downloaded' }`, but the DTO schema for export status only allows `'pending' | 'completed'`. Caching an out-of-schema value can break components that read this query and undermines type safety. Prefer tracking “download started” in local component state, or extend the DTO/schema to include this state under a different key.

body: Renaming this enum member from can_view_audit_records to can_view_activity_logs changes the output of str() on this member. Since build_deterministic_uuid() hashes that string, this rename silently changes the permission's UUID. All existing role_permissions.id values in the DB still store the old UUID. This will cause a KeyError in PERMISSIONS_ID_INDEX lookups and a 500 error for every user with this permission.

author: avinash-b-nasuni
body:
The naming follows two distinct source patterns from the old code:

Audit* (service/concept-level names) → ActivityLogs* — e.g., AuditUserDto → [ActivityLogsUserDto](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html), AuditKeyDto → [ActivityLogsKeyDto](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html), AuditRoleDto → ActivityLogsRoleDto
AuditRecord* (entity-level names) → ActivityLog* — e.g., AuditRecordDto → ActivityLogDto, AuditRecordAction → [ActivityLogAction](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html), AuditRecordTarget → [ActivityLogTarget](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html)
So the apparent inconsistency is intentional — it preserves the 1:1 rename mapping from the original naming.

author: avinash-b-nasuni
body: This is a known trade-off. Existing exports were written under [{tenant_id}/exports/audit/{file_name}](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) (old value "audit") and the new value ["activity_logs"](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) means new exports go to a different prefix. Old files are not deleted — they just won't show up in new list_exports calls. Since exports are short-lived (downloaded then expired), there's no data loss risk.

author: Copilot
body: Changing the export file type value from the previous `audit` prefix to `activity_logs` changes the S3 key prefix (`{tenant}/exports/<type>/...`). During a rolling deploy, exports created by an older version (stored under the old prefix) may become undiscoverable for download. Consider a compatibility approach (e.g., keep the value as the old prefix for one release, or make `list/get` check both prefixes).
